text:
Alice: @channel heads up — scheduling a rolling maintenance window for our GPU fleet in us-east-1 this weekend.
Alice: Reason: NIC firmware + CUDA driver security patch that blocks a networking regression we've seen on some A100 nodes.
Alice: Target start: Sat 2024-09-14 02:00 UTC. Expected duration: 6 hours for the region, but each AZ will be a 20–45m rolling drain.
Miguel: Oncall — can you confirm coverage? I'll be monitoring rollout and wake for pager if anything spikes.
Miguel: Also need a quick pre-check list we can run before we take each node out.
Priya: I can pair on the pre-checks. Minimal list: current pod eviction count, GPU utilization <5% for last 10m, no active long-running jobs in the node pool.
Priya: Suggest `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader` as automated checks.
Jordan: Capacity note: Dedicated customers on reserved pools should be unaffected unless their pool shares physical hosts with the nodes being rebooted. We'll prefer non-dedicated pools first and keep a 15% spare margin.
Casey: I'll prepare customer comms: two emails — one for Dedicated customers (SLA note + opt-out) and one for hosted (info only). Draft out by EOD today.
Alice: Rollout plan summary: 1) cordon + drain node 2) run preflight checks 3) apply firmware + reboot 4) postflight validation (node joins, kubelet ready, model-serving quick smoke)
Alice: Draining command we're using: ```kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120``` and then `ssh node 'sudo /usr/local/bin/apply_firmware && sudo reboot'`
Priya: Postflight smoke: `kubectl get nodes | grep NotReady` should be empty for the AZ after 10m; validate model latency percentiles on the probe route for 10 minutes.
Miguel: If we see abnormal pod restart rates or sustained 95th latency > baseline + 100ms, abort further drains and roll back to last stable firmware image.
Jordan: Cost ops: we might need to spin up temporary burst instances in us-west-2 for heavy inference jobs if utilization spikes — estimate cost ~ $3k for the window if we need full fallback.
Casey: Exec comms ready. I'll include the fallback plan and expected times. Also note: customers can request blackouts for Dedicated pools by replying within 24h.
ops-bot: Scheduled job created: maintenance-gpu-us-east-1-1742001234, reminders at -24h and -1h, and automated runbook attached: /runbooks/gpu_firmware_rollout.md
Alice: Two operational asks: 1) Team — please avoid deploying model rollouts in us-east-1 during maintenance window. 2) Monitoring — add a temporary alert to lower the noise threshold for node reboots.
Miguel: I'll watch the alerts and hold off auto-restarts that could overlap with the drain; will coordinate with SRE pager if we hit an incident.
Priya: I'll run the first AZ as a dry-run Thursday at 03:00 UTC (no reboot, only cordon/drain checks) and post results here.
Alice: Perfect — thanks. If anyone has constraints (customer blackouts, oncall unavailable) speak up now so we can reschedule specific AZs.
Jordan: Noted — capacity team will stand by to scale a fallback fleet in us-west-2 if required.
Casey: Final draft sent to #legal for compliance review and then I'll send customer emails by 17:00 UTC.
Alice: OK closing this thread. I'll post the final runbook link after the dry-run. :white_check_mark:
